clusters.name: Bea's birth, 1995–1996
clusters.reason: Around Bea's birth in March 1995, within the following eighteen months: your mother worn out and on edge with the baby by August, drawing away from your father who worked late most nights by November, you with stomach aches and missing school by February 1996, your brother Jonah in shouting matches with your father by May, and your mother not returning to her job by September. Each person's shift follows close on the others, and the period settles where your mother's functioning has dropped and the household has found a new balance around the baby.
